preconditions.description: n and k are powers of two, and 1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 1024
The total number of coffee tastings allowed is at most 15000
The array a is not fixed initially and may adapt to queries, but is consistent with all answers given so far

postconditions.description: The output must be a single line starting with '! ' followed by the number of distinct coffee varieties d in the array a

postconditions.expression: all(query in ['? c', 'R'] for query in stdout.splitlines() if query.strip() != '! d')
postconditions.description: All queries must be either a valid coffee tasting request ('? c') or a memory reset ('R')

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip().startswith('?')) <= (3 * n * n) // (2 * k)
postconditions.description: The total number of coffee tasting queries ('?') must not exceed (3n²)/(2k)

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() == 'R') <= 30000
postconditions.description: The total number of memory reset queries ('R') must not exceed 30000
